information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule with only anchor_policy and anchor_contract visible, conditionally changes the causal polarity of anchor_policy, and emits exactly one complete executable state. The third consumes only that state with task_constraints and loop_structure, and the final call consumes the resulting closure with task and candidate_hypothesis. Raw trigger evidence and side reports do not propagate beyond the transition.
name: Anchor Polarity Transition Relay
organization: four-call sequential executable lineage with one evidence-triggered authority-state transition on the anchor reentry edge

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule and compare its carried commitments with reentered anchor_policy under anchor_contract. When an anchor-contingent obligation is the sole visible support for a carried commitment, reverse anchor_policy from constructive precedent to counterexample-only evidence and revise the same artifact accordingly. Regardless of transition, emit exactly one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_polarity_transition, assess the single inherited executable state against only reentered task_constraints and loop_structure, reconcile visible obligations within its established evidence authority, and emit one complete executable policy closure.

Consume constraint_structure_transition, assess the inherited complete executable closure against only reentered task and candidate_hypothesis, reconcile remaining visible obligations in that same artifact, and emit one complete policy.
